01/06/2014

Dr. Charles White
Bayview Private Hospital
81 Canyon Road
Bayview

Dear Dr. White,

RE: Ms. Lola Duval, Aged 24 years

I am writing to refer Ms. Lola Duval into your care who requires an early review with detailed    Comment [OET1]: MS Duval: Use the last
evaluation and possible treatment for her symptoms which are suggestive of hyperthyroidism        name always inside the body of your letter.
due to Grave’s disease.

Ms. Lola Duval has had history of anxiety and insomnia for which she has been taking sleeping
pills occasionally. Her mother had depression. Ms. Duval has been complaining of sudden           Comment [OET2]: had depression = now
indefinable loss of weight, of ten kilogram in the past two months.                               has no depression and we do not know this
                                                                                                  information so better use: she has a family
                                                                                                  history of depression related to her mother.
Yesterday, Ms. Duval presented to my clinic complaining of occasional palpitations, tremors,
sweating and heat intolerance for the past two months. These symptoms were associated with
fatigue for a month. On examination, her vital signs were normal, and her weight was 55 Kg,. An
enlarged non-tender thyroid glands was detected, and tremors were seen in both her hands. Her     Comment [OET3]: gland
Eye examination revealed exophthalmos with lid lag. Based on her signs and symptoms routine
blood tests, ECG, thyroid function tests were requested.

Today Ms. Duval’s test reports were available. The ECG showed sinus tachycardia. and the blood
tests revealed a Llow TSH level of less then 0.05 mU/L , elevated T3 and T4 levels at 15pmol/L    Comment [OET4]: than
and 40pmol/L, respectively. The results have been explained to the patient with the provisional
diagnosis. Furthermore, I have requested for thyroid auto-antibody tests and thyroid scan.        Comment [OET5]: Do not use academic
                                                                                                  connectors like furthermore and moreover in
                                                                                                  OET instead use: Therefore,
In view of the above, I’m referring Ms. Duval to you for further assessment and treatment.
Should you may have any queries, kindly do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
